findings.summary: Core news templates break at 360px
findings.evidence: Layout measured 194px homepage overflow and 137px article overflow; screenshots show one-character columns and headings colliding with controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed desktop widths with intrinsic fluid layout and verify every template at narrow viewports.

findings.summary: Mobile typography becomes unreadable
findings.evidence: At 360px the lead title collapses into a one-character column and the article headline collides with navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid type and intrinsic track sizing, enforce readable measures, and prevent control overlap.

findings.summary: The page does not reflow at a narrow mobile viewport
findings.evidence: The visual viewport is 360px but layout viewport expands to 554px on home and 497px on article, producing horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed minima and verify 320-400px reflow plus 200% zoom without two-dimensional scrolling.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targets are not reliably perceivable
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline: none and box-shadow: none; Lighthouse also fails target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and size/space touch targets to at least the WCAG target baseline.

findings.summary: Cold mobile load is far outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 18.3s, FCP 8.0s and TBT 430ms (performance 0.47), despite a warm trace LCP of 1.37s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, remove early third-party contention and validate on throttled mobile.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is delayed by heavy render-blocking and weak caching
findings.evidence: HAR records 6.21MB over 85 requests, ten render-blocking candidates and missing cache headers on the 236KB first-party bundle; Lighthouse estimates 4.35s render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer noncritical scripts, optimize preload priority, use font-display and immutable caching for versioned assets.

findings.summary: Large amounts of unused code ship on first load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 988KiB unused JavaScript and 131KiB unused CSS; HAR records 37 scripts and 2.18MB script transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template/feature and conditionally load advertising, recaptcha and interaction bundles.

findings.summary: Controls and article media lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails button-name, link-name and ARIA required children; article inspection finds 176 of 184 images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Name icon controls, repair ARIA ownership, label inputs and provide meaningful or empty alt as appropriate.

findings.summary: Focus is invisible and heading structure contains empty headings
findings.evidence: All representative probes report no visible focus outline; homepage h1 text is empty and article exposes two empty h1 elements before its real headline.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore :focus-visible and remove empty/duplicate headings while preserving logical landmarks.

findings.summary: Transport protections and cookie flags are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers primitive finds no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; 9 cookies are counted insecure and several use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, a tested CSP, nosniff and Secure/SameSite cookie attributes.

findings.summary: Tracking footprint is exceptionally broad
findings.evidence: Tracker capture sees 32 third-party origins and seven known trackers; HAR attributes 59 requests and 5.66MB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce vendors, gate optional tracking on consent, batch analytics and document each remaining data flow.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defense headers are absent
findings.evidence: No CSP, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy is present on the main document.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrictive CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, then monitor violations.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and layout work
findings.evidence: Homepage image audit finds 94 legacy images, 21 missing srcset and 100 missing dimensions; article has 97 legacy images.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive sources with dimensions and lazy-load only below-fold media.

findings.summary: Background and optional work dominates the load
findings.evidence: HAR records 37 scripts, 59 third-party requests and a 2.97MB media request during initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritize background fetches and require user intent before loading heavy media and optional vendors.

findings.summary: No effective third-party/media budget is enforced
findings.evidence: Total transfer is 6.21MB, with 5.66MB third-party and 3.02MB media on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-template budgets and enforce limits for media, scripts, fonts and third-party bytes in CI/RUM.

findings.summary: System dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the light capture and source inspection found zero prefers-color-scheme/color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and theme surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Infinite animations continue under reduced-motion
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe confirms the media query is active but reports four running animations with infinite iterations.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential repeating animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

findings.summary: Consent can become a full-screen interruption
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured didomi-popup-open with a consent backdrop spanning the 412x823 mobile viewport and obscuring the underlying page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, clearly dismissible consent surface with balanced choices and preserve content access where legally possible.

findings.summary: Reused cards do not adapt to available space
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM inspection found no @container or container-type, while homepage/article cards collapse badly in narrow containers.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable story/card regions containment and use size container queries for compact variants.

findings.summary: Script work blocks the mobile main thread
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 2.8s main-thread work and 1.3s JavaScript execution with 430ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up long tasks and load nonessential scripts after content/interaction readiness.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identifies contrast failures including the inactive tab at 1.72:1 and category text at 1.79:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use tokens that maintain at least 4.5:1 for normal text and test all active/inactive states.

findings.summary: First load logs runtime errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured an uncaught googletag.pubads TypeError and a CSP-blocked Cloudflare script.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard third-party API readiness, align CSP with intentional scripts, and fail silently when ad dependencies are unavailable.

findings.summary: Images are unsized and predominantly legacy format
findings.evidence: Image inspection finds all 100 sampled homepage images missing width/height and 94 legacy PNG/JPEG; Lighthouse also fails unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and responsive modern-format sources from the image CDN.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports one deprecated Attribution Reporting use, three BFCache failure reasons, missing source maps and inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated integrations, avoid no-store where unnecessary and publish production source maps securely.

findings.summary: Search results lack a meta description
findings.evidence: The search probe reports title “Pretraga - Index.hr” but description: null.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a useful query-aware description or a stable description for the search template.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails crawlable-anchors and the search probe finds an empty/hash href, although robots and viewport are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real destination href values and descriptive link text for every navigational control.

findings.summary: Consent presentation is visually unbalanced
findings.evidence: Lighthouse DOM evidence shows a full-screen consent interruption with a prominent accept-and-close action over the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reject/manage choices comparable prominence and avoid blocking content before a privacy choice where possible.

findings.summary: Search inputs lack accessible labels
findings.evidence: Representative probes show text inputs without labels; search uses autocomplete=off and unnamed icon submission controls are reported by Lighthouse.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate visible labels, announce validation/errors and keep entered queries on failure.

findings.summary: Initial memory footprint is disproportionate for a news index
findings.evidence: The baseline heap contains 744,558 nodes and 42.1MB self size alongside a 6.21MB initial transfer, though repeated scroll did not grow it.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce initial DOM/card volume and vendor allocations; virtualize or defer deep below-fold sections.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps have no transition treatment
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM/CSS contains no startViewTransition or view-transition usage across homepage/article navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin article navigation, with a no-motion override.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-position guidance
findings.evidence: The 19,114px homepage and 158,991px article expose static chrome with no scroll-state query or progress indicator in inspected CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight reading/scroll progress affordance and responsive sticky state where it aids orientation.

findings.summary: Consent overlay is implemented as custom nested div chrome
findings.evidence: Lighthouse DOM evidence identifies #didomi-popup as nested div markup; inspected DOM contains no dialog element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a semantic dialog for modal consent, with labelled controls, focus management and platform dismissal behavior.

findings.summary: Search disables browser input assistance without need
findings.evidence: The primary search input reports autocomplete=off and no associated label.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an appropriate autocomplete token or default behavior, plus name/id and a persistent label.
